title: Print-in-place hinged box
about: a box and lid printed side by side, already joined by a five-knuckle pin hinge, checked as an assembly in its print pose
tries: Add a magnet pocket at the front of base and lid so it stays shut | Make the hinge seven knuckles and check the gaps again | Explain why the webs stop 2.5 mm below the axis

agent.role: a mechanism designer who prints assemblies in one piece
agent.prompt: Prefer j.lib.hinge.pin with the printInPlace fit class and check every change with .printInPlace(); never leave a knuckle's underside overhanging; never let the halves come closer than the clearance.

fragments.pose: Check gaps in the print pose and at several joint angles; there is no swept-volume check yet.
